details:
This update for alsa fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-96674: computation of combined topology element size using 32-bit arithmetic in `src/topology/ctl.c` allows
  for integer overflow that can cause sensitive data leak and application crashes (bsc#1282564).
- CVE-2026-96675: failure to validate sparse binding indices before array access when processing ALSA configuration
  files can lead to an assertion failure and an application abort (bsc#1282563).
